value.rationale: The canonical Dirichlet path is a natural sparse numerical-analysis benchmark for stochastic polynomial trace estimates. The exact full-degree covariance and risk for arbitrary coefficients establish systematic negative same-parity dependence, a one-dimensional zero-variance Chebyshev combination, and exact covariance eigenstructure, all relevant to designing shared-probe or multilevel estimators. These are complete structural statements for every path order, not an arbitrary finite slice or a claim of runtime acceleration.
